공통.장르: a live-action Korean sparkling-drink commercial on an outdoor public basketball court in Seoul, from a hot late afternoon to blue dusk

누구.HANGYEOL: the same Korean man of 22 as in the first frame in every frame — short black hair in a textured crop with a tousled fringe, ears sticking out slightly, clean monolid eyes, lean cheeks; a plain white crew-neck t-shirt with no print, soaked dark with sweat, and navy basketball shorts. His identity — the same face, features and skin marks — stays exactly as in the first frame; only his expression moves as the action says.
누구.FRIEND_HAND: only the hand and forearm of a friend standing outside the picture, wearing a deep ruby-red silicone wristband — the friend's face and body never appear.
누구.CAN: the soda can exactly as in the first frame — dark navy with its printed label; the printing, logo and letters never change, move, melt or multiply, the can never changes shape, and no new text appears on it.
누구.DRINK: the drink is a clear, sparkling, translucent ruby-pink liquid with fine bubbles, glowing when lit from behind; it soaks straight into the asphalt and never forms a dark pool or a thick red puddle.
누구.STEAM: any steam is thin, translucent white water vapour — never smoke, never fire, never flames, never a puddle.

공통.보기: LOOK: keep the first frame's light, colors, brightness and white balance to the very end unless the action says the light changes; natural motion blur and real texture, no beauty filter; no new text, letters or logos appear anywhere — nothing beyond what the first frame already shows; no extra people.
공통.소리: SOUND: silent clip — no dialogue, no narration, no music.

판.설명: 컷 1 — 땅바닥 매크로: 달궈진 코트에 떨어진 땀방울의 왕관이 가라앉고 김이 「치익」 피어오름(슬로)

샷.동작: The crown splash of the single drop of sweat, frozen in the first frame, collapses back into the hot asphalt over the first 0.6 s, its tiny droplets falling back down; at the same time the thick curl of white steam keeps hissing up from the spot, rising and twisting in the hard orange backlight, and the heat shimmer wavers above the ground. Nothing else moves; no person, no hand, no new drop. Shot on a high-speed macro camera at 1000 fps, played back slowly.
샷.카메라: locked off at ground level — the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last: no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no shake.

소리줄.켬: SOUND: only his own hoarse, breathless voice saying this one Korean line, his heavy breathing, and quiet outdoor court ambience — no music, no other voices, no sound effects.

판.설명: 컷 2 — 같이 뛴 친구가 서서 폰으로 내려다봄: 대자로 누워 헐떡이며 「아… 목 타 죽겠다.」(시댄스가 연기 · 소리 켬 — 이 판의 목소리를 한결 목소리로 삼음)

샷.동작: He lies flat on his back on the court exactly as in the first frame, arms flung out; the grin of the first frame fades into exhausted panting within the first half second — gasping for air, chest heaving, squinting against the low sun. At about 0.6 s, between two breaths, he says hoarsely in Korean, half to himself, in his own natural tired voice: "아… 목 타 죽겠다." — his lips clearly forming the Korean words, no shouting, no exaggerated face. Then he keeps panting with his mouth slightly open. His arms and legs stay where they are; the basketball stays against his hand.
샷.카메라: handheld phone held by the friend standing over him, pointing down — a small natural hand shake and a slight drift, staying at the same height and framing.
